note: Upstream catboost 1.2.10 ONE-HOT training fixture (SPEC-OH-29). Generated OFFLINE with thread_count=1 and a pinned seed; NEVER regenerated in CI (upstream quantization is run-to-run nondeterministic) — CI only READS these artifacts. At least one cat feature's stored `values` array is NON-ascending, so the first-referenced vs ascending-hash ordering rule is genuinely discriminated.

npy_schema.cat_cols.json: raw categorical columns as STRING labels (the A4 form calc_cat_feature_hash hashes)
npy_schema.model.cbm: upstream one-hot model, FlatBuffers (the interop target)
npy_schema.model.json: upstream one-hot model, json (splits + leaf_values + borders + categorical_features.values)
